name: Converso CRM Lite
author: converso

sections.description:
Converso CRM Lite is built for freelancers, agencies, local businesses, and small teams that need a simple CRM directly inside WordPress.

The plugin includes a visual Kanban pipeline, contact management, WhatsApp lead capture, smart WhatsApp links, a floating WhatsApp button, manual order management, optional WooCommerce integration, activity tracking, basic statuses, basic services, lead filters, and CSV export.

Converso CRM Lite works without external platforms. You can start managing customer inquiries from WordPress and keep a clear view of each lead in the pipeline.

All features included in this plugin are free and fully functional.

External services

Converso CRM Lite can open WhatsApp links through https://wa.me/ when a visitor or administrator chooses to continue a conversation in WhatsApp. The visitor’s message text may be included in the WhatsApp URL only after the visitor submits the lead capture form or clicks a WhatsApp link. WhatsApp is provided by Meta. Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service Privacy policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the converso-crm-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP file from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open Converso CRM from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure your business data, WhatsApp settings, statuses, and services.
sections.faq:
Is Converso CRM Lite free?

Yes. Converso CRM Lite is free to use.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is optional. If WooCommerce is active, Converso can help connect leads and orders.

Does the plugin store personal data?

Yes. Converso stores lead and contact data needed to operate the CRM. It also includes privacy policy text and supports WordPress personal data export and erasure tools.

Can I use WhatsApp without the WhatsApp Cloud API?

Yes. Converso CRM Lite includes WhatsApp links, a floating button, and lead capture without requiring the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API.
